user_query: I am planning a movie night with my friends this weekend. Can you recommend the four latest upcoming movies and provide me with their details? Additionally, I would like to search for movies in the comedy genre with a minimum IMDb rating of 7.5. Please sort the results by rating in descending order and include the Rotten Tomatoes rating. Lastly, can you fetch some relevant images for these movies?

TaskList.description: Fetch the four latest upcoming movies and their details.
Search for comedy genre movies with a minimum IMDb rating of 7.5.
Sort the comedy movies by IMDb rating in descending order and include their Rotten Tomatoes ratings.
Fetch relevant images for the selected movies.
